task_description: Fix the KiroCrew Flow bug (observed live on issue #107) where a state transition does not remove the previous state, leaving overlapping crewflow:* state labels (e.g. crewflow:todo AND crewflow:review) that stall the next stage's dispatch. Introduce an atomic transition_state(labels, novo_estado) domain helper that guarantees exactly one state label while preserving modifiers and type/priority labels, wire it into the driving adapter and dev prompt so every state change is atomic, add tests proving todo->dev->review never accumulates states, and reinforce the '1 estado por vez' invariant in README and steering.

verification.summary: python3.12 -m ruff check flow/ deployment/ clean; mypy flow/ clean (49 files); pytest 590 passed, 1 failed (only the pre-existing environmental root+chmod test test_prompts_loader.py::TestRenderPromptFallback::test_template_corrompido_ilegivel_usa_fallback, present at baseline and unrelated). No Dockerfile so docker build not applicable. POST-REVIEW (semantic review 2026-09-19-163710 NEEDS_CHANGES): addressed Issue 1 (dev->review not enforced engine-side) and Issue 3 (no engine-path test). Added _apply_review_transition + defensive _enforce_review_exclusivity pre-pass in deployment.py and domain-pure state_labels_present() in state.py so the engine deterministically collapses to exactly crewflow:review on the reviewer path AND reconciles the ambiguous #107 (todo+review) case the scanner discards. Added 4 engine-path tests (586 -> 590). Issue 2 (redundant todo->dev dual writer) intentionally kept as belt-and-suspenders. Final suite after post-review cleanup: 590 passed, 1 known-failure; ruff+mypy clean.

review.notes: v1 NEEDS_CHANGES: dev->review (the exact #107 accumulation transition) remained LLM-driven. Follow-up added engine-side deterministic enforcement (_apply_review_transition) plus a defensive _enforce_review_exclusivity pre-pass that reconciles the ambiguous todo+review issue the scanner drops (the concrete #107 case), and the pure state_labels_present() helper. v2 APPROVED: verified revert-sensitivity of the new engine-path tests; all five acceptance criteria met. Two non-blocking v2 notes: (1) dead if/pass branch removed in commit 256ac70; (2) per-cycle list_by_state call intentionally left as-is (low cost).
